libraries.reason: The shared install name is not on the npm registry. The registry refused the unscoped name idfkit to its similarity filter, and npm support confirmed on 2026-09-14 that no exception is possible, so the facade moved to @idfkit/idfkit. It has not been published under that name yet, while the scoped packages ship on schedule. The pin stays at the level this repository can actually resolve, which is none, and the components are reached under their own names until the facade is published.
libraries.tracked: The first publication of @idfkit/idfkit (idfkit-js, unification task T101). When it lands, this entry takes the published level, and the fallback specifiers in model-server/src/service.ts and model-server/src/inputs.ts are deleted.
